name: Zed
about: Static repository-local configuration inventory. User-level state, runtime overrides and effective permission resolution are outside this reader.

mcp-server.note: Configured MCP server; tool-level permission is separate.

mcp-tool-auto.note: Named tool approval; Roo additionally requires the user-level global auto-approval switch, which this repository reader cannot establish.

tool-allow.note: Explicit permission entry; patterns and denying rules retain their original provenance.

env-endpoint.note: Named endpoint environment override; value withheld.

env-credential.note: Named credential environment entry; value withheld.

hook.note: Configured lifecycle command; never executed by this reader.
